findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Frontend 6. "An error that should show UI uses `error.tsx` at the nearest route segment; an error that should crash to a boundary above is thrown, never swallowed and logged."
findings.note: A non-404 failure of GET /api/me/agent is logged and swallowed, then rendered as a page-wide PageUnavailable instead of thrown to an error.tsx. Fix that keeps the spec: throw, and add an error.tsx scoped to the dashboard segment (e.g. a route group) rendering the same 'Couldn't load your dashboard' EmptyState. The 404 not-linked state and the region-level null loaders are data states, not flagged. The reviewer also proposes amending this rule (see rules_to_revisit). [re-review: CONFIRMED]

findings.citation: docs/agents/coding-standards.md: Frontend 8. "Compose Tailwind classes from the tokens in `tailwind.config`; an arbitrary value (`w-[123px]`) needs a comment saying why it isn't a token."
findings.note: Arbitrary font sizes in changed lines with no comment. Cheap fix: a one-line comment each. The pattern is project-wide (233 uses); the reviewer proposes amending the rule. [re-review: CONFIRMED]

findings.citation: Constraints: the user's docker-compose stack is never written to by a test.
findings.note: rollSeededAgentInvoiceIntoThePast falls back to `docker compose exec postgres psql` when E2E_DATABASE_URL is unset. It copies the accepted manager-invoice-review-queue pattern.
Duplicated Code: rollSeededAgentInvoiceIntoThePast exists twice; this feature created the second copy. Delete the spec's local copy and import from ./helpers.
Currency is checked only with isNotEmpty(), never as the Agent's own USD.

findings.citation: Tickets' Observability: 'a label naming the endpoint and the response status'
findings.note: The log labels 'agent contracts' and 'agent contract requests' name neither the endpoint path nor which Contract failed.
loadIdentity repeats backendFetchJsonOrNull's shape only to tell 404 apart. Mostly disappears if F1 is fixed by throwing.
gotoWithSession is defined identically twice; extract it to a shared visual helper.

The current billing month is computed inline, about the 8th copy (AgentInvoiceController:140, AgentStandingAmountController:97, ClientInvoiceController:284, FeeController:136...). Only this line changed; the rest is debt. Suggested: BillingMonth.current().
`perContract.flat() as AgentRequest[]` asserts away a null check; a type-guard filter would drop the cast.

The 'Open queue' link in dark mode is #6c5cec on #141926, 3.66:1, below 4.5:1 for 13px text. The auditor rated it blocking, but these lines are unchanged by this branch and the same class is used in 4 places app-wide, so it is a pre-existing defect of the design tokens rather than of this diff. The orchestrator typed it smell, so it goes to debt as a real accessibility defect.

SurfacePage always renders the 'Demo data … synthetic' note, now under a page showing real Agent data, which contradicts the spec's goal. Unchanged lines; shared with the still-demo Manager and Client dashboards.
'Local Support Fees — September 2026' wraps on desktop, so its value sits about 20px below the other three stat values.
On mobile, the Recent Requests rows truncate the Contract label and the requester, with no way to see the full value (consider line-clamp-2).
The unavailable value '—' has no text alternative (sr-only 'Unavailable', with the dash aria-hidden).
On primary cards, an unavailable '—' renders in reserved indigo, with the emphasis of a real figure.

On mobile, the TopBar subtitle truncates the country ('Jordan Ellis · Unite…'), which is the only information the subtitle adds. [re-review by reviewer-spec: OPEN — the fix dropped the name from the header, contradicting story 1; see F19.] [Superseded by F19's fix (7186194): the name is restored and the subtitle wraps on mobile instead of truncating, which cures the original smell.]
The Rollout Advance meta uses a hard-coded en-US Intl.NumberFormat with no .tnum, unlike Money/formatMoney.

findings.citation: User story 1: "As an Agent, I want my dashboard's header to show my own name and country, so that I know at a glance the page is about me." Solution table: "Header name and country … `<name> · <country label>`".
findings.note: Introduced by the fix pass (F17, 3095d5c): the subtitle became countryLabel(agent.country) alone. The name only in the viewer chip does not meet story 1, which the spec keeps separate from story 2. Fix: restore `<name> · <country>` and cure the mobile truncation another way (e.g. let it wrap), or amend the spec first.

findings.citation: Testing decisions 3: "sign in as the Agent and show the dashboard naming Jordan Ellis"
findings.note: Introduced by the fix pass: the assertion went from 'Jordan Ellis · United States' to banner text 'United States'. No e2e or visual spec now asserts the Agent's name. Resolves with F19.
